title: Akhil knows what his mother Manisha watched, read and did while he was elsewhere
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Akhil knows what his mother Manisha watched, read and did while he was elsewhere, about c. 2020s at Manisha and Akhil's home, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: just sending information I could be watching a movie upstairs and he could be or downstairs and he could be in a whole another room of the house you know playing on his iPad can't hear anything and I could come back up and he'll tell me exactly what happened in this movie

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens made The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children who are said to read minds, and on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels she passed on what a mother named Manisha told her about her son Akhil. According to Manisha, she could watch a movie on one floor of their home while Akhil played on his iPad in another room, unable to hear it, and afterwards he would tell her exactly what had happened in the film. If true, it would mean information can pass from mind to mind without the senses.
